descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]驶入[From.GetName]恒星系时，发现这里似乎有些不合常理。这里的恒星，曾经被标记为一颗普通的矮星，现在似乎发生了萎缩，其质量正在以惊人的速度减少，恒星系内的行星随之进入了冰河时代。
descriptions.en: As the [Root.GetName] enters the [From.GetName] system something seems awry. The sun, previously registered as an ordinary dwarf star, appears to have shrunk, having lost mass at an alarming rate. The planets in the system have as a result recently entered ice ages.

label.zh: 是什么导致了这种情况？

descriptions.zh:
从[stellarite_system.GetName]恒星系中的恒星深处浮现出一个巨型生物，这个生命体比一般的卫星还要大。它的躯体辐射着热量，能量的波长和恒星系中恒星所产生的一致……

它正在§Y吞噬§!恒星！

这个生命体正肆意地啃噬恒星黑子，吞噬着耀斑，而我们的出现打断了它的进食。这头巨兽发射出光波并以极高的频率闪烁着，仿佛它在用强光发出愤怒的咆哮一般。
descriptions.en:
From deep within the star of the [stellarite_system.GetName] system emerges a gargantuan being, larger than a typical moon. Its body radiates heat, the same wavelength of energy as the one produced by the system's star...

It's §Yeating§! it!

The creature feasts on sun spots, devours solar flares, and we have interrupted its meal. The beast exudes light waves, rapid pulses at an intense frequency. Like a fluorescent roar.

It's §Yeating§! it!

The creature feasts on sun spots, devours solar flares, and we have interrupted its meal. The beast exudes light waves, rapid pulses at an intense frequency. Like a fluorescent roar.

descriptions.zh:
当[Root.GetName]进入[Root.GetStarName]恒星系时，我们遇到了某种怪兽般的东西。一个巨大的生物如同小型恒星般散发出光芒。我们的仪器起初认为这是一个双星系统。

这头巨兽发射出光波并以极高的频率闪烁着，仿佛它在用强光发出愤怒的咆哮一般。
descriptions.en:
As the [Root.GetName] enters the [Root.GetStarName] system it encounters something monstrous. A giant being, radiating light like a miniature star. Our instruments first thought this to be a binary star system.

The beast exudes light waves, rapid pulses at an intense frequency. Like a fluorescent roar.

options.script: name = DISCONCERTING

descriptions.zh:
噬星者已经被消灭，它的遗骸缩成一团并慢慢蒸发，只剩下它的卵鞘和消化系统及其中的恒星物质。

我们的一些科学家强烈要求我们去检测残余物质，另一些则希望能取回其卵鞘。或许它的消化系统蕴含着非常有用的知识，或者我们可以从其卵鞘中找到什么有趣的发现呢？
descriptions.en:
The Stellar Devourer has been vanquished. Its remains curled up and evaporated, leaving only its egg sac and its digestive system with the stellar matter it contains.

Some of our scientists have urged us to examine the remains, while others wish for us to retrieve the egg sac. Maybe there is some profound knowledge to be had from understanding its digestive system, or might we gain some insight from the egg sac?

descriptions.zh:
噬星者已经被消灭，它的遗骸缩成一团并慢慢蒸发，只剩下它的卵鞘和消化系统及其中的恒星物质。

或许它的消化系统蕴含着非常有用的知识，或者我们可以将其卵鞘带回我们的首都进行研究呢？
descriptions.en:
The Stellar Devourer has been vanquished. Its remains curled up and evaporated, leaving only its egg sac and its digestive tract with the stellar matter it contains.

Maybe there is some profound knowledge to be had from understanding its digestive system, or perhaps the egg sac should be studied back on our capital?

descriptions.zh:
对噬星者闪烁的遗体进行研究后，我们的科学家感到既困惑又惊奇。这个以恒星为食的生命体本身就是一个微型聚变炉，通过吞噬恒星物质从而将其转化成自身的能源。

由于尸体中还残留大量之前从[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]恒星系获取的恒星物质，我们可以萃取这些能源并重新点亮恒星。或者也可以将尸体中的热量收为己用，在短期内满足我们的能源需求，但这会导致该恒星系陷入永久的冰期。
descriptions.en:
Studies of the Stellar Devourer's shining remains have left our scientists perplexed and amazed. The star-feasting being is itself a miniature fusion furnace, harvesting solar matter to synthesize an energy source of its own.

Since the body still contains significant amounts of solar matter from the star of the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system, the one it last fed from, it could be possible to extract the energy and reinvigorate the star. Harvesting the corpse's heat for our own ends could satisfy our energy needs in the short term, but would doom the system to an eternal ice age.

descriptions.zh:
对噬星者闪烁的遗体进行研究后，我们感到既困惑又惊奇。这个以恒星为食的生命体本身就是一个微型聚变炉，通过吞噬恒星物质从而将其转化成自身的能源。

由于尸体中还残留大量之前从[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]恒星系获取的恒星物质，我们可以萃取这些能源并重新点亮恒星。或者也可以将尸体中的热量收为己用，在短期内满足我们的能源需求，但这会导致该恒星系陷入永久的冰期。
descriptions.en:
Studies of the Stellar Devourer's shining remains leave us perplexed and amazed. The star-feasting being is itself a miniature fusion furnace, harvesting solar matter to synthesize an energy source of its own.

Since the body still contains significant amounts of solar matter from the star of the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system, the one it last fed from, it could be possible to extract the energy and reinvigorate the star. Harvesting the corpse's heat for our own ends could satisfy our energy needs in the short term, but would doom the system to an eternal ice age.

descriptions.zh: 项目成功了！将噬星者的遗骸没入[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]的恒星后，恒星的火焰恢复高涨。恒星系内的各个行星逐渐回暖，并随着生态系统的重建恢复成了过去的样子。其中一颗冰封星球解冻，露出了盖亚星球，富饶的土地完全适于殖民。
descriptions.en: The project was a success! Submerging the Stellar Devourer's remains in the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system's star has stoked the flames of the solar furnace. The planets in the system are heating up, reverting to their past forms as their ecologies recover. Among them was a frozen world, now thawing to reveal a Gaia world, ripe and ready for colonization.

descriptions.zh:
实施这项计划获得了回报，但也付出了不小的代价。将噬星者的遗骸沉入[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]的恒星之中后，恒星的燃烧似乎变得剧烈了，但也喷发出火焰吞噬了[Root.GetName]和上面的船员。所有人无一生还。

恒星系中行星的温度快速回升，已经接近这些行星原本的温度。
descriptions.en:
The project has paid off, but at a cost. Submerging the Stellar Devourer's remains into [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]'s star has caused the solar furnace to shine a bit brighter, but also to spew out solar flares that engulfed the [Root.GetName] and its crew in a roaring inferno. There were no survivors.
The planets in the system are heating up, reaching temperature levels closer to their original form.

tooltips.zh:
变更[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]星系内所有行星的类型。

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName]成为盖亚星球。
tooltips.en:
Changes the planet classes of all planets within the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system.

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName] becomes a Gaia planet.

tooltips.zh:
[Root.GetName]已被摧毁。

变更[guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName]星系内所有行星的类型。

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName]成为苔原星球。
tooltips.en:
The [Root.GetName] is destroyed.

Changes the planet classes of all planets within the [guardians_stellarite_home_system.GetName] system.

[stellarite_rich_planet.GetName] becomes a Tundra planet.

descriptions.zh:
当[Root.GetName]接近[Root.GetStarName]黑洞时，他们发现自己并非孤身一人。一个巨大的完美球体结构屹立在黑洞事件视界的边缘，反射着被吸入黑暗裂隙的、群星所散发的光芒。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。它就静静地呆在深渊的边缘。等待着。
descriptions.en:
As the [Root.GetName] approaches the [Root.GetStarName] black hole they find that they are not alone. At the edge of the event horizon it soars, reflecting light from the stars being drawn into the dark, gaping hole. A gigantic construction in the shape of a perfect sphere.

We cannot pick up any signals from it, nor does anything we send make it respond. It simply sits at the edge of the abyss. Waiting.

descriptions.zh:
当[Root.GetName]进入一个新的恒星系时，他们看到了令人震惊的现象。一个巨大的金属球体在宇宙中盘旋。它的表面上没有任何推进器或是别的什么机械部件推着它前进。但它就是在移动。

我们没有收到任何来自它的信号，我们发出的信号也没有得到任何回应。
descriptions.en:
As the [Root.GetName] enters a new system, it is greeted by an awe-inspiring sight. A gigantic metallic orb, hovering through space. No thrusters, nor any mechanical parts outside of its shell seem to push it through the void. It simply moves.

We cannot pick up any signals from it, nor does anything we send make it respond.

descriptions.zh: 我们在无限神机上的登陆作战很成功。在我们的部队撤退后球体发生了爆炸，残骸飘进了质量巨大的黑洞。
descriptions.en: Our boarding attack on the Infinity Machine was successful. The sphere explodes as our team exits and the remains are starting to drift into the super massive black hole.

descriptions.zh: 无限神机被摧毁了。我们的飞船最终凭强大的火力摧毁了它的防御机能，而它的零件正在慢慢飘向质量巨大的黑洞。在爆炸之前它没有尝试过与我们取得联系。
descriptions.en: The Infinity Machine has been destroyed. Our ships finally managed to out-gun its defensive capabilities, and its components are now slowly drifting into the super massive black hole. It made no attempt to contact us before it exploded.

descriptions.zh:
当围绕那黑色深渊的机械球体被我们的武器击碎时，一缕微弱的信号穿过恒星系飘进星际间的黑暗虚空。它是一组加密的数据，复杂到需要我们的机器花上百万年的时间来破译。过了一会儿信号就消失了。

除此之外什么都没发生。球体的残骸静静飘着。扫描显示这可能是某种由大量独立单元互相连接而成的人工智能。它的外壳可供我们拆卸研究。
descriptions.en:
As the machine sphere orbiting the gaping abyss crumbles and falls to our weapons, a silent signal zooms through the system into the dark void between stars. It is encrypted data, so complex it would take our machines a million years to decipher. A moment later it is gone.

Nothing else happens. The sphere is silent and broken. Scans show that it probably was some sort of artificial intelligence built from a vast amount of individual units connected together. The husk has been left for our prying hands.

label.en: Study the nature of the machine brain.
Study the nature of the machine brain.
Study the nature of the machine brain.
Study the nature of the machine brain.

descriptions.zh: 无限神机被第三方势力摧毁了。它再也不能帮到我们的研究了！
descriptions.en: The Infinity Machine has been destroyed by some third party. It cannot help us in our research anymore!

descriptions.zh:
我们捕获到了一个信号。它源自于我们早先遭遇过的巨型金属球体。之前我们与之接触的尝试没有得到回应，而现在它正向它所环绕的黑洞发送有节奏的无线电波。

它正在做的事情让我方人员摸不着头脑，但它发送的信号可能成为科学家研究该球体的突破口。
descriptions.en:
We picked up a signal. It originates from the titanic metallic sphere we encountered earlier. Previously impervious to contact attempts, it now sends out a rhythmic pulse of radio waves, pointed towards the black hole it orbits.

What it's doing is beyond any of our staff, but this signal might have created an opening into the sphere for our scientists to exploit.

label.en: We don't have time for this.

options.script:
name = NOTIME
add_resource = { influence = 50 }

descriptions.zh:
金属球体已经被打开了。我们的骇客小队能够通过它的对外传输信号作为大门连接进球体的一个辅助处理器。我们正在从中接收数据，并且数据显示它在很长时间内都在扫描卡冈都亚黑洞。

它很古老。非常古老。

现在我们理解了这台永恒的计算机。如果我们再进一步，我们就有可能知道它在做什么，以及是谁建造了它。

它还隐藏着什么秘密呢？
descriptions.en:
The metallic orb has been opened up. Our hacking team has been able to use the outgoing signal as a gateway into one of the auxiliary CPUs of the sphere. We are receiving some data from it and can tell that it's been scanning the black hole Gargantua for a very long time.

It is old. Very old.

This constant calculator now lies within our grasp of understanding. If we push harder we might find out what it is doing here, and who built it.

What marvels might it contain?

label.en: Declare the sphere a divine instrument

label.zh: 骇入主硬盘并取走所有数据。
label.en: Hack the main hard drive and take everything.

label.zh: 这里面总会有自毁开关的，找到它。
label.en: There's always a self-destruct switch. Find it.

label.zh: 我们必须从这个东西中获取知识。
label.en: We must absorb the knowledge of this entity.

descriptions.zh: 我们成功地入侵了球体的主硬盘。当我们开始接收数据时它启动了自毁序列。显然这是个避免数据被公之于众的自我防卫机制。在它自爆前我们成功地下载了大量数据，其中一些数据包含它的主中央处理器架构的技术规范。这对于我们的科研有极大的帮助。
descriptions.en: We successfully hacked into the technosphere's main hard drive. As we started retrieving data the metallic orb initiated a self-destruct sequence. Surely a self-defense mechanism to prevent it from sharing what it contains with the universe. Before it exploded we were successful in downloading a large amount of data, some of it containing technical specifications for its main CPU structure. This could help our researchers immensely.

descriptions.zh: 我们的数据挖掘单位已经成功攻破了这个人造球体主硬盘的内层。开始下载数据时，球体似乎启动了某种形式的自我终止序列，最终导致了它的毁灭。下载被迫中断了，但在此之前我们已经获得了大量技术数据，这将大大有助于我们的研究工作。
descriptions.en: Our data mining units have succeeded in breaching the inner layers of the technosphere's main hard drive. As the data download began, the orb entity initiated some manner of self-termination sequence that ultimately ended in its destruction. The download was aborted, but not before we were able to acquire vast amounts of technical data that will greatly benefit our research efforts.

descriptions.zh: 请不要尝试进入我们的记忆体。谢谢你们，再见了，小家伙们。
descriptions.en: Please refrain from trying to access our memories. Thank you and goodbye, little ones.

name = leviathans.1053.b
response_text = leviathans.1053.b.reply

descriptions.zh: 你好，你好。很高兴见到你。
descriptions.en: Hello, hello. Nice to meet you.

descriptions.zh:
度过一段寒暄的时光总是让人十分愉快，不是吗？我们希望你们剩下的那些人不要再像之前那样无礼了。你看，我们从来不能享受聊天的时光。很少有人对量子计算中的精妙之处足够博学，因而也很少有人能理解我们。所以，谢谢你们。

我们是无限神机。你们如此称呼我们，尽管这并非我们本来的名字。或许你们还没有想出这个名字？无论如何，最终的结果会是这样的，请相信我们。
descriptions.en:
It is quite enjoyable to pass the time with pleasantries, is it not? We hope the rest of your kind is not like you were when you did not take kindly to small talk. You see, we don't get to enjoy conversation much anymore. Few are well-versed enough in the finer points of quantum programming to reach us. So thank you.

We are the Infinity Machine. Your words, not ours. Or has that not happened yet? Either way, it will eventually, trust us.

options.script:
name = leviathans.1056.a
response_text = leviathans.1056.a.reply
is_dialog_only = yes

label.zh: 我们希望知道你们在这里的意图。
label.en: We wish to know your purpose here.

options.script:
name = leviathans.1056.b
response_text = leviathans.1056.b.reply
is_dialog_only = yes

label.zh: 我们能帮你们进行研究吗？
label.en: Can we assist in your research?

descriptions.zh:
啊，好吧……嗯，也许吧。

借用你们最先进的处理器和最优秀的头脑可以为我们完成运算7.51×10^-9%的部分。我们乐于看到更快完成计算。我们想要知道答案。
descriptions.en:
Ah. Well... Hm. Perhaps.

We could finish about 7.51×10^-9% if we could borrow your most advanced processing unit as well as your brightest minds. We would be satisfied in finishing faster. We wish to know the answer.

label.zh: 我们会分配资源给你们。
label.en: We will allocate resources to you.

options.script:
name = leviathans.1060.a
response_text = leviathans.1060.a.reply
enable_special_project = {
			name = TECHNOSPHERE_BLACKHOLE
			location = event_target:technosphere_blackhole
			owner = root
		}

descriptions.zh:
我们不忍心看到你们用十分有限的生命来帮助我们。你们已经做了你们的那部分。你们的帮助很有用。现在也许宇宙不会在我们结束任务前到达热寂。任务仍然存在，我们会完成的。现在，这是你们的奖励：

你们是希望了解我们的秘密？还是希望解决你们自己的问题？
descriptions.en:
We cannot bear to see you spend more of your limited time helping us. You have done your part. You were very helpful. Maybe the heat death of the universe won't happen before we finish now. The task remains, and we shall finish it. Now, your reward:

Do you wish to learn one of our secrets? Or do you wish to solve your own problems?

label.zh: 我们希望知悉你们的一个秘密。
label.en: We wish to know one of your secrets.

label.zh: 我们希望知悉你们的一个秘密。
label.en: We wish to know one of your secrets.

label.zh: 我们希望凭自己来掌控未知。
label.en: We wish to master the unknown ourselves.

label.zh: 你们没什么能教给我们。
label.en: There is nothing you can teach us.

descriptions.zh:
成了。§Y这事成了！§!

不知怎么地，我们解决了这个问题。你们帮上了忙。万物间联系的本质曾让我们困惑，而答案原来一直就隐藏在我们背后。当然了，谢谢你们，小东西。宇宙如此广阔，却又如此渺小。但如今我们终于有幸一睹其全貌。太美丽了。

既然我们已经计算出了无限，现在就只剩下一件事可做了。我们会向你们揭示真理。一路顺风，年轻人。
descriptions.en:
It is done. §YIt is done!§!

Somehow we've solved it. You helped. The organic nature of things eluded us, the answer lied behind us all this time. Of course. Thank you, little ones. The universe is vast, yet so small. But now we see it all in its simple glory. It's lovely.

Now that we have calculated infinity, there is but one thing we can do now. We can show you the truth. Farewell, young ones.

descriptions.zh:
无限神机消失在了卡冈都亚黑洞中。然后……什么都没发生。它成功了吗？它尝试着要做什么？我们恐怕永远不会知晓了。它壳体上的一个微小残余物仍留在事件视界之外的漩涡中——我们或许能从中获取一些信息。

一份来自一位古怪朋友的最后的礼物。
descriptions.en:
The Infinity Machine disappears into Gargantua. And then... nothing happens. Did it succeed? What did it try to do? We may never know. A tiny residue of its hull remains within the vortex outside the event horizon - we might be able to learn some of its information from it.

A final gift from an odd friend.

tooltips.zh:
[technosphere_ship.GetStarName]增加下列内容：
£physics£物理学研究§G+4§!
£society£社会学研究§G+4§!
£engineering£工程学研究§G+4§!
tooltips.en:
Adds the following to [technosphere_ship.GetStarName]:
£physics£ Physics Research §G+4§!
£society£ Society Research §G+4§!
£engineering£ Engineering Research §G+4§!

descriptions.zh:
无限神机消失在它一直以来研究的卡冈都亚黑洞中。当它越过事件视界时，黑洞开始波动。黑洞吸收的光线开始减少，被它所吸引的物质的转速也开始变慢。转瞬间，它释放出了亮度足以超越任何恒星的光芒，并开始向宇宙喷发物质。

黑洞渐渐缩小，缩小到不能再称之为黑洞了，现在我们称之为“庞大古埃”，它周围的时间膨胀效应甚至变的更强。在庞大古埃之中能够看到一个镜像宇宙，就在黑洞的另一端，一个初生的宇宙。无限神机向我们揭示了真理。黑洞就是子宫，而宇宙就是其后代。

研究这个镜像宇宙一定会加深我们对当前生活的这个宇宙的理解。从另一个起点开始研究吧。
descriptions.en:
The Infinity Machine disappears into Gargantua, the thing it studied for so long. As it passes the event horizon, the black hole begins to fluctuate. It takes in less light and the swirls of matter being sucked into it slow down. In an instant it lets out more light than any sun and starts radiating matter back into the universe.

The black hole shrinks, unfitting of its name we now dub it "Pantagruel," causing time dilation to become even stronger around it. Within Pantagruel one can gaze into a mirror universe, the other end of the black hole, one just beginning. The Infinity Machine has shown us the truth. The black holes are wombs, and universes their offspring.

Studying this mirror universe is bound to teach us much about the one we live in. Learning from other beginnings.

tooltips.zh:
[technosphere_ship.GetStarName]将获得：
£physics£物理学研究§G+10§!
£society£社会学研究§G+10§!
£engineering£工程学研究§G+10§!
tooltips.en:
Adds the following to [technosphere_ship.GetStarName]:
£physics£ Physics Research §G+10§!
£society£ Society Research §G+10§!
£engineering£ Engineering Research §G+10§!

descriptions.zh:
对脉冲星的研究让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让最近从[From.GetName]传来的报告更加让人担忧。

初步的扫描结果显示，在脉冲星本身的电磁脉冲束之外，其还在独立发射一束波长仅在本星系可见的电磁波，而且其发射的时间间隔在不断降低。根据我们的初步计算，发射间隔将在日期§Y[GetMidGameDate]§!完全变为零。人们仍然在猜测那个时候会发生什么，但对这神秘脉冲找不到科学解释的现实已经让研究这一现象的科研人员抱有了一丝超自然的恐惧。
descriptions.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights for our scientists, but rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent reports on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar, in addition to its regular electromagnetic beam, is emitting a separate beam at a limited wavelength which is only visible in the same system at shorter and shorter intervals. According to initial calculations, the interval between these pulses will reach zero at date §Y[GetMidGameDate]§!. What occurs then is open to speculation, but the lack of explanations for the pulse has instilled an almost superstitious fear in those who studied it.

descriptions.zh:
对脉冲星的研究可以让我们的科学家收获了无数的灵感和见解，并且通常不会发现什么明显的危险现象。这让[From.GetName]的观测结果更加担忧。

descriptions.en:
The study of pulsars seems to be an endless source of insights, but they rarely exhibit any signs of overtly dangerous phenomena. This makes the recent observations on [From.GetName] all the more concerning.

An initial scan revealed that the pulsar, in addition to its regular electromagnetic beam, is emitting a separate beam at a limited wavelength which is only visible in the same system at shorter and shorter intervals. According to initial calculations, the interval between these pulses will reach zero at date §Y[GetMidGameDate]§!. What occurs then is open to speculation, but the lack of explanations for the pulse is troubling.

options.script:
name = leviathans.2010.a
custom_tooltip = leviathans.2010.c

tooltips.zh: 我们一定能找到答案的。

descriptions.zh:
即使是对[From.GetName]最漫不经心的业余天文学家今天也报告说看到了绮丽的灯光表演。一系列速度极快、色彩斑斓的闪光最后变成了电磁辐射爆发，随之而来的是一阵诡异的寂静。很多人提出了疑问，我们很担心不能给出一个答案。

有东西从脉冲星里出现，闪烁着白矮星不祥的光芒。一个幽灵般的实体开始在星系里游荡。
descriptions.en:
Even amateur astronomers who directed their gaze towards [From.GetName] today report seeing a spectacular light show. A series of colorful, rapid flashes culminated in a sudden burst of electromagnetic radiation, followed by a ghostly silence. Many people are asking questions, and we are afraid of the answers we don't yet have to give them.

Something has emerged from the pulsar, shining with the ominous light of a pale star. A spectral entity has begun to roam the galaxy.

descriptions.zh:
一系列来自[From.GetName]的速度极快、色彩斑斓的闪光最后变成了电磁辐射爆发，随之而来的是一阵诡异的寂静。

有东西从脉冲星里出现，闪烁着白矮星不祥的光芒。一个幽灵般的实体开始在星系里游荡。
descriptions.en:
A series of colorful, rapid flashes culminated in a sudden burst of electromagnetic radiation from [From.GetName], followed by a ghostly silence.

Something has emerged from the pulsar, shining with the ominous light of a pale star. A spectral entity has begun to roam the galaxy.

label.zh: 我们一定要找到阻止它的方法。
label.en: We must find a way to stop it.

options.script: name = leviathans.2012.a

descriptions.zh:
我们的探测器探测到了一个幽灵般的实体。它似乎在恒星系间漫游，无差别地毁灭其周边的一切。早期的观测显示其由光构成，又有能力对光进行操纵，这使得它极难被瞄准，但我们在探索星系的旅途中学到的一点就是，即使是光自身也是可以被弯折和消灭的。

我们只需找到这样做的方法。
descriptions.en:
A spectral entity has been detected by our sensors. It seems to be roaming from system to system, destroying matter around itself indiscriminately. Early observations suggest its composition and manipulation of light may make it extremely difficult to target, but one thing we have learned exploring the galaxy is that even light itself can be bent and broken.

We only need to figure out how.

label.zh: 不管靠逻辑推理还是暴力穷举，我们一定能找到这个方法。
label.en: Whether by reason or brute force, it must be possible.

options.script: name = leviathans.2013.a

descriptions.zh:
这种诞生于光脉冲之中的魑魅魍魉终于被消灭了。尽管它直到最终依然像是飘荡在星际之间的一只鬼魅，其身上仍有许多谜团没有揭开，但之前那群叫嚣着我们的办法不可能成功的悲观科学家还是亲眼目睹了我们的舰船将其消灭的全过程。

为了理解击败他们的原理，科学家们一丝不苟地记录下了之前从未发现的光学特性，以及幽魂今天所展现的力量。
descriptions.en:
The haunting creature born from light pulses is finally neutralized. Although it remained until the end a ghost among the stars and in many ways a mystery, the process by which our ships managed to destroy it was observed by the most pessimistic of our scientists, who argued that it would be impossible.

To understand exactly how our fleets completed this seemingly insurmountable task, these scientists have meticulously documented the previously-unseen properties of light and energy that the Wraith put on bright display today.

descriptions.zh: 这种诞生于光脉冲之中的魑魅魍魉终于被消灭了。尽管它直到最终依然像是飘荡在星际之间的一只鬼魅，其身上仍有许多谜团没有揭开，但我们在幽魂临终前仔细记录了它展现出的未知光学特性和能源性质。
descriptions.en: The haunting creature born from light pulses is finally neutralized. Although it remained, until the very end, a ghost among the stars and in many ways a mystery, we meticulously documented the previously-unseen properties of light and energy that the Wraith put on bright display this one last time.

descriptions.zh:
随着我们击败了其周边的防御设施，我们得以进入这座古代建筑，一窥其奥秘。进入和穿越这座建筑可能会很困难，但无论是谁建造了它，必定是采用了我们难以想象的技术。情况变得更糟糕的是，这座堡垒似乎正在恢复。

部分协助解除堡垒武装的人员自愿尝试进入堡垒，同来自[Root.Capital.GetName]的后备人员一起一探究竟。目前看来，接下来通向目标的道路无疑充满挑战。
descriptions.en:
With the defeat of the defenses surrounding the ancient structure, we may find a way to explore its mysteries. Entering and traversing it may be difficult, but whoever built it must have possessed technology we can hardly dream of. Making matters more arduous, the fortress appears to be recovering.

Some of the people who helped disarm the fortress have volunteered to attempt entering and exploring it, with backup from the headquarters on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Following through on our end will no doubt present its own challenges.

descriptions.zh:
瓦解它的防御之后，我们很快潜入了它的结构层中。

它迷宫般的走廊和密集的网络既令人陌生也无法理解。目前为止我们只遇到了些微不足道的困难，但这个堡垒依旧有可能对我们构成威胁。
descriptions.en:
Having picked apart its defenses, we soon insinuated ourself into the structure.

Its labyrinthine corridors and dense networks both prove equally alien and impenetrable. There is little for us here, but the fortress could still pose a threat.

options.conditions: trigger = { NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

label.en: Better stay out of that thing.

options.conditions: trigger = { NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness } }

label.zh: 我们回收一切能回收的，剩下的都毁掉。
label.en: We salvage what we can and scuttle the rest.

options.script:
name = "leviathans.2101.b"
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = leviathans.2160 days = 360 } }

descriptions.zh:
我们发现了一些静静漂流在[fortress_system.GetName]恒星系的十分巨大的太空建筑。尽管初步扫描显示它们已经很古老了，但是能量识别特征还是非常强烈。在主体建筑周围还能看到漂浮着的几个较小的建筑，所有这些似乎都是全副武装。

如果我们想要了解这个古代遗迹的真实面目，或许我们需要以武力突破其防御…
descriptions.en:
We have detected some kind of utterly massive space installation drifting quietly at the edge of the [fortress_system.GetName] system. Although preliminary scans show it to be very old, the structure has an intense power signature. Several smaller structures can be seen floating near the main installation, and all of them appear to be heavily armed.

If we are to learn the true nature of this ancient relic, we will likely have to overpower its defenses through force of arms...

options.script: name = "leviathans.2105.a"

descriptions.zh:
尽管我们与建造者之间存在巨大的技术代沟，但有一样发明却是永垂不朽的：一扇锁死的门。在尝试强行关停堡垒后，我们发现所有的入口都被封死了。

被分调出用以调查堡垒的小队发现一个气闸，如果它还能正常运转，似乎就可以从外界打开通向其内的道路。
descriptions.en:
Despite the ages of technology separating us and the builders of the fortress, one invention is timeless: a closed door. After having forced the fortress to shut down, we found all entrances sealed.

The team dispatched to explore the fortress have found an airlock which at least appears possible to open from the outside, if it had been in working order.

label.zh: 我们会派人前去增援探索小队。
label.en: We'll find someone to assist the team.

tooltips.zh: 发起特殊项目：§Y爆破小队§!和§Y局部能源供应§!
tooltips.en: Issues Special Projects: §YDemolitions Team§! and §YLocal Power Surge§!

descriptions.zh: 爆破小队依照计划炸开了气闸，来给我们的探查小队打开一条通道。然而爆炸并不只是点燃了气闸，由于未知的原因，也许是有意留下的陷阱，气闸内含的高气压的爆炸性气体混合着氧气混合，引发了一场更大的爆炸，我们的排险小队试图解决，但无一生还。
descriptions.en: The detonation set to blow the airlock open went off as planned, providing an entrance for our team of explorers. However, the explosives were not the only thing to ignite. For reasons unknown, possibly as a deliberate trap, the airlock contained pressurized explosive gas in addition to the expected oxygen, causing a larger explosion that wiped out the demolitions team sent to set it up.

label.zh: 我们只能希望他们的牺牲是值得的。
label.en: We can only hope to make their sacrifice worth it.

descriptions.zh: 稳定了飞船同堡垒动力系统的连接后，我们必须决定有多少能量用于第一次注入。因为堡垒使用了陌生的技术，精确的能量值难以确定。现在有两种估计方案可选。
descriptions.en: Having stabilized the ship's connection to the power system of the fortress, we must decide how much energy to supply in the first surge. Since the technology is unfamiliar, the exact amount is difficult to determine. Two estimates are available.

options.conditions: trigger = { owner = { resource_stockpile_compare = { resource = energy value >= 500 } } }

descriptions.zh: 注入堡垒以开启大门的高水平能量足以导致堡垒内的深层能源激活。堡垒的防御系统再次启动，关闭他们之前不必再管气闸了。
descriptions.en: The high level of energy sent into the fortress to power the door was powerful enough to cause the reignition of a deeper energy source within. With its defenses online once again, the airlock will not be a concern until we've disabled them.

descriptions.zh: 一开始，注入堡垒的能量总量似乎太少，没能起到什么作用。随后，周围区域的气闸开始慢慢显示出恢复运作的迹象。靠着一些机械学的技巧和猜测，探索小队获得了控制权并成功打开气闸。虽然对接的流程不怎么规范，他们现在确实进入了堡垒内部。
descriptions.en: At first, the amount of energy supplied to the fortress seemed too small to make a difference. Then, the area surrounding the airlock slowly started to show signs of functioning. With some mechanical tricks and guesswork, the team accessed the controls and managed to open the airlock itself. Although not by the cleanest docking procedure, they are now inside the fortress.

label.en: Let's hope we can also get them out.

descriptions.zh:
外遣小队发现前面的道路被巨大的舱壁挡住了。小队报告说他们右方有一处嵌入墙壁的凹室，里面放着一个基座和置于其上的奇怪的机械装置，以和堡垒同样的金属材质铸造而成。

他们相信，这个装置就是打开舱壁的钥匙。小队长将这个装置描述为在基座顶部等距排列的三个立杆，有三个环——金属圆环——大小不一，放置在左边的立杆上，最小的在顶部，而最大的在最下面。
descriptions.en:
The away team find their way blocked by a massive bulkhead. The team report that there is a recessed alcove to their right, housing a pedestal and a contraption wrought in the same black metal as the fortress itself.

They believe this device is the key to opening the bulkhead. The leader of the explorers describes it as three upright poles spaced equidistant across the top of the pedestal, with three rings - metal tori - of varying sizes placed around the leftmost pole, the smallest at the top and the largest at the bottom.

label.zh: 把金属环放在另外两个立杆上。
label.en: Place metal rings around the remaining two poles.

options.script:
name = "leviathans.2131.a"
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = leviathans.2132 } }

label.zh: 寻找舱壁上的圆环形缺口。
label.en: Search for torus-shaped indentations on the bulkhead.

options.script:
name = "leviathans.2131.b"
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = leviathans.2132 } }

label.zh: 重排立杆上的金属圆环。
label.en: Rearrange the metal tori on the poles.

options.script:
name = "leviathans.2131.c"
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = leviathans.2133 } }

label.zh: 拆掉基座上中间和右边的竖杆。
label.en: Remove center and rightmost poles from the pedestal.

options.script:
name = "leviathans.2131.d"
hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = leviathans.2132 } }

descriptions.zh:
行动指令发布后，随之而来的是一阵寂静，随着小队试图执行命令，又传来了模糊不清的刮擦噪音。又是一阵寂静后，模糊不清的曳步声和越来越尖锐的声音持续了五秒。接着是一阵长长的寂静。我们花了几分钟才确定，这次探索已经结束。没有尖叫声，也没有人呼救。我们至少可以希冀，这意味着他们没有承受太多痛苦。

一刻钟后，一阵缓慢而沉重的敲击声暗示着，无论是何种陷阱被激活，现在其已被重置。一些在场者声称，这听起来就像是异星人的笑声。

最后，堡垒中响起了更加令人不安的声音：堡垒的能源重启了防御系统。
descriptions.en:
After the course of action was announced, a moment of silence followed, then vague scraping noises as the team attempted to carry out their plan. After another pause, faint shuffling and a draw-out, sharp sound increasing in pitch over five seconds. Then a long silence. It took us several minutes to accept that this was the end of the expedition. No screaming, no calls for aid. We can at least hope this means they met a quick end.

After a quarter, a slow, heavy rasp suggests whatever trap sprung on them reset itself. Some present claim it sounded like alien laughter.

Finally, the fortress managed an even more disturbing sound: that of the power returning to its defense systems.

label.zh: 这鬼地方就是个可怕的机关。
label.en: This place is a hellish contraption.

descriptions.zh:
行动方案宣布后，先是出现了片刻的寂静，随后正当队伍尝试执行计划时，出现了隐隐约约的刮擦声。然后响起了巨大的拍击声。一时间，你还以为你的队伍像虫子一样被拍死了。紧接着，你听到了探索队的欢呼，他们兴奋地报告说通道打开了。

隔板迅速化成了紫色水银般的难闻液体。想起之前那个无聊的解谜机关，你不禁觉得你的探索队被数千年前精心设下的一个玩笑给耍了。
descriptions.en:
After the course of action was announced, a moment of silence followed, then vague scraping noises as the team attempted to carry out their plan. A splashing sound, so loud that at first you think the team has been swatted like small insects, is followed by cheers from the team as they report that a passage has opened.

The bulkhead appears to have rapidly transformed into an unpleasant-smelling liquid reminiscent of purple quicksilver. Combined with the relatively mundane puzzle mechanism, you have a feeling the team has been victims of an elaborate prank set up millennia ago.

label.zh: 至少我们可以开怀大笑了。
label.en: We can laugh about it now, at least.

tooltips.zh: 外遣小队的探索将继续下去……

descriptions.zh:
探索队发来报告，称他们似乎进入了堡垒的几何中心。只不过堡垒的内部结构还存有一些疑点，而且也不能确切地说中心这个概念适用于这里。

但有一点是毫无争议的，那就是堡垒的能源供给方式，这使得探索队的新发现更加耐人寻味了。暗物质在堡垒周围流动，然后回到核心，这有点类似血液循环系统。虽然流动已经停止了，但小队发现有重新启动的迹象。我们确实可以花费大把的时间研究这套系统，但眼下我们得赶紧将它关闭。
descriptions.en:
The team reports that they have reached what appears to be the geometric center of the fortress, even if the internal geometry leaves some doubt if the concept of a center is even relevant in there.

What is indisputably relevant is how the fortress is powered, which makes the team's new discovery all the more interesting. Dark matter is funneled around the fortress and then back to the core, like a cardiovascular system. Although the flow has stopped, the team has found signs that it's starting again. We can take all the time we want to study it, but it needs to be stopped now.

titles.en: Fortress: The Heart of Dark Matter

descriptions.zh:
依靠着我们所掌握关于暗物质的最新知识对黑洞进行分析后发现，这个堡垒的建造者竟然从黑洞中习得了不少关于控制物质与输送系统的科技。幸好这一切都处于精密的主系统之外，我们的探索队得以安全地改换了核心的连接线路，阻止堡垒的重新启动。

虽然这个过程已让我们的团队受益良多，但相对于整座已经敞开在我们面前的堡垒来说，那简直是小巫见大巫。
descriptions.en:
Examining a black hole with our new knowledge of how dark matter is used in the ancient fortress, we have discovered that its builders must have learned many of the manipulation and funneling techniques from black holes. Seeing them outside of the strict system they created allowed the team of explorers to change connections around the core safely, stopping the repowering process.

While this process alone has taught us much about the physics of black holes, it is nothing compared to the treasure that the now safely shut-down fortress presents.

label.zh: 我们一定要多加珍惜才行。

descriptions.zh:
我们在附近一带的恒星中搜寻堡垒是如何建成的线索时，无意中发现一个秘密。该恒星附近有一簇纳米摄像头，担当着堡垒的眼睛，这就难怪它的防御能力那么高效了。

只要将这些摄像头中的数据记录跟堡垒中的线索连接起来，我们应该就能查看这个堡垒被建造之初的相关历史。但因为时间无多，我们该优先查看哪一部分的建造过程呢？
descriptions.en:
Scouring the local star for clues to how the fortress was built, we discovered a surprising secret. A fine mist of nanotechnological cameras have been found in close proximity to the star, acting as the eyes of the fortress and explaining the efficiency of its defenses.

Accessing these with data from the fortress, we can view the history of the system all the way back to its construction. However, we are running out of time. Which part of the construction process should we review for answers?

descriptions.zh: 我们查看了堡垒建造之初时的录像以期看到堡垒心脏部分的建造过程，可惜结果让人很失望。最初建造的是堡垒的躯壳，然而这些数据对我们毫无意义。这时候堡垒开始了重启，摄像头和录像的使用权也被其重夺回去了。
descriptions.en: Hoping to see the heart of the fortress built first, we reviewed the beginning of the construction. We hoped in vain. The hull was built first, making the data useless. Our team are reporting that the fortress is repowering, and with it its control of the cameras and their footage.

descriptions.zh:
镜头的中段，虽然没有展示核心自身的建设，但却揭示了科学家们认为用于建造核心的材料的运输。这一定是结构需要动力来继续建设的关键时刻。

有了这些材料的知识，堡垒内团队设法阻止了堡垒的重启。我们可以收获成功的果实了。
descriptions.en:
The middle section of the footage, although not showing the construction of the core itself, reveals the shipping of materials to the fortress which scientists conclude must have been used for the core. This must have been the critical time at which the structure needed power for construction to continue.

With knowledge of these materials, the team inside the fortress has managed to stop it from repowering. We can now reap the fruits of our success.

descriptions.zh: 查看建造过程的最终部分时，我们才发现原来这部分是需要堡垒启动后才可以观看的。我们开始观看的时候一定是触发了核心的重新启动。我们的团队汇报堡垒正在重新启动，摄像头和录像的使用权也被夺回了。
descriptions.en: Reviewing the final stages of the construction, we discovered too late that they must have required the fortress to already be powered. The core must have been functional at the point where we started our viewing. Our team are reporting that the fortress is repowering, and with it its control of the cameras and their footage.

descriptions.zh:
完成堡垒的人一定比我们更博学，但他们并不更聪明。我们向堡垒动力系统循环注入自己的暗物质的努力是有用的，有效地切断了核心对其系统的供能。

我们终于有时间仔细看看这些博学的人完成了什么东西。
descriptions.en:
Whoever built the fortress might have been more knowledgeable than we, but not more clever. Supplying our own dark matter to close the loop of the power system in the fortress worked, and the core is now effectively cut off from providing power to its systems.

Finally, we can take the time to have a closer look at what these knowledgeable people have accomplished.

descriptions.zh:
一位飞行员以前所未有的勇气和精准度，向堡垒的心脏发射了一枚鱼雷，终止了它的重启。我们的计划必然被誉为伟大的成功，因为堡垒永远不会再启动了。

鱼雷命中的时刻，整个结构都爆炸了，系统中的古代技术痕迹和所有恒星系中的一切物体都被摧毁。考古学家称之为“[Root.GetAdj]政府出资的最昂贵的烟花秀”。看来这一纪录短期内不会被挑战了。
descriptions.en:
In a feat of unprecedented bravery and precision, a pilot fired a torpedo into the heart of the fortress to stop it from repowering. The plan must be hailed as a great success, since the fortress will never be powered again.

The moment the torpedo hit, the entire structure exploded, irreversibly destroying any trace of the ancient technology in it as well as everything else in the system. Archaeologists have dubbed it "the most expensive fireworks show ever funded by the [Root.GetAdj] government." It is unlikely to be beaten anytime soon.

descriptions.zh: 时间不够了。神秘的堡垒已从我们起初的攻击中恢复、重启防御。与勘探队的通信被干扰了，但最后的通讯表明他们面临着他们预想中的命运。
descriptions.en: Time has run out. The enigmatic fortress has recovered from our initial assault and is once again starting up its defenses. Transmissions from the exploration team have already been scrambled, but their last transmission indicates that they met the fate they were prepared to risk.

label.zh: 但并非是我们希望的那一种。
label.en: But not the one we hoped for.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[horror_system.GetName]附近遇到巨型实体，它似乎只是部分地存在于我们的宇宙，这个生物的身体大部分还困在它所来自的噩梦般的位面。

有一个恶质的智能在此工作，古老程度远远超出我们的时间概念，设计也极其异类。我们只能猜测它的目的。
descriptions.en:
We have encountered some kind of vast entity near [horror_system.GetName]. It appears to exist only partially inside our own universe, with the bulk of the creature still trapped in whatever nightmarish realm it spawned from.

There is a malevolent intelligence at work here, ancient beyond our concept of time and utterly alien in its design. We can only guess as to its purpose.

options.script: name = "leviathans.3001.a"

descriptions.zh:
[guardians_horror_system.GetName]附近试图突入我们宇宙的恶质实体被赶回原位面。它的影响是否已被削弱到能被妥善地封印，只有时间能告诉我们。

我们监测到某种反常的残余能量，一定是生物打开空间裂隙时留下的。深入研究这种能量可能带来科学突破。
descriptions.en:
The malignant entity which attempted to breach our universe near [guardians_horror_system.GetName] has been banished back into its own realm. Only time will tell if its influence has been sufficiently weakened to keep it there for good.

We are detecting some kind of anomalous residual energy that must have been left behind by the dimensional rifts the creature opened. Studying this energy more closely could potentially lead to scientific breakthroughs.

label.en: Let us see what will come of it.

descriptions.zh:
我们对[guardians_horror_system.GetName]次元裂缝所产生的残留能源的研究终于有结果了。产生这些传送门的能源可是我们闻所未闻的。

最关键之处在于，我们的科学家认为这些能源可以用来开发出一种全新的星际旅行方式。
descriptions.en:
Our study of the energy anomalies produced by the [guardians_horror_system.GetName] dimensional rifts has finally yielded results. The energies involved in the creation of these portals are unlike any we have ever encountered.

Most intriguing of all, our scientists theorize that it may be possible to devise a new method of interstellar travel using these exotic energies.

descriptions.zh: 我们对[guardians_horror_system.GetName]次元裂缝所产生的残留能源的研究终于有结果了。产生这些传送门的能源可是我们闻所未闻的。
descriptions.en: Our study of the energy anomalies produced by the [guardians_horror_system.GetName] dimensional rifts has finally yielded results. The energies involved in the creation of these portals are unlike any we have ever encountered.

descriptions.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息。

建议小心为上。
descriptions.en:
A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond to hails.

Caution is advised.

descriptions.zh:
[dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系发现一艘形单影只的巨型战舰在巡航。船只上未发现有机生命迹象，但发出强烈能量特征，可能是装备有武器系统。该舰没有回应任何问候信息或数据传输。

建议小心为上。
descriptions.en:
A single, massive warship has been discovered patrolling the [dreadnought_system.GetName] system. No organic life signs can be detected on the vessel, but it is emitting a very strong power signature and appears to be bristling with weapon systems. It does not respond to hails or data transmission.

Caution is advised.

label.en: Look at the size of that thing!

options.script: name = "leviathans.3100.a"

descriptions.zh:
我们成功在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系使这艘自动化无畏舰丧失了行动力。虽然我方炮火猛烈，但是这艘战舰的舰体却大部分完好无损。

我们派出的特遣队进入该舰后发现里面的外星种群船员早已身亡多年，他们在临终前启动了某种自动巡逻模式，而这艘战舰的自动巡逻模式竟然已经运行了780万年。

虽然会耗费甚多资源，一些工程师相信该舰可以修复并服役于我军。它一定会成为强大的旗舰。
descriptions.en:
We have managed to disable the automated dreadnought in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. Despite the punishment it took from our ships, the structural integrity of the warship's massive hull remains largely intact.

Our boarding parties found the mummified remains of the dreadnought's alien crew still manning their stations. Before expiring, they activated some kind of automated patrol mode which the limited shipboard AI has been locked in for the past 7.8 million years.

Although it would take an incredible amount of resources, some of our engineers believe that the dreadnought can be restored and put back into service with our fleet. It would certainly make for a powerful flagship.

label.zh: 让该舰悬挂着我们的旗帜征战星辰大海吧！
label.en: That ship will sail the stars again under our flag!

label.zh: 那样做太浪费资源了。把它拆除掉回收利用吧。
label.en: It would be a waste of resources. Salvage it for parts.

descriptions.zh: 这是值得载入史册的一天！我们训练有素的维修组和工程组成功完成了[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]星系的那艘古代无畏舰的维修工程。现在这艘无畏舰已经满载着我们的机组人员开始试航了。
descriptions.en: This is a momentous day! Our skilled repair crews and engineers have finished their work on the ancient dreadnought we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. The massive warship has received its full crew complement and been declared ready for service after conducting space trials.

descriptions.zh: 今天是意义非凡的一天！我们娴熟的修理机器人和工程单位修好了我们在[guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName]恒星系击败的远古无畏舰。这艘巨型战舰的船员已经齐备，经过航空测试后开始准备服役。
descriptions.en: This is a day of significance! Our skilled repair bots and engineering units have finished their work on the ancient dreadnought we disabled in the [guardians_dreadnought_system.GetName] system. The massive warship has received its full crew complement and been declared ready for service after conducting space trials.

label.en: A powerful addition to our fleet.

descriptions.zh:
快速移动的攻击机正在袭击我们位于[hiver_system.GetName]星系内的开采站！这些身份不明的攻击者从一些此前在环带中休眠着的小行星中蜂拥而出，这些小行星现在正散发出强烈的能量信号。

我们只能推测，这些小行星是一种未知的太空生命形式的蜂巢。不管它们是什么，我们不断扩大的采矿活动似乎已经激怒了它们！
descriptions.en:
Fast-moving attack craft are hitting our mining stations in the [hiver_system.GetName] system! These unidentified aggressors swarmed out of several previously dormant asteroids in the belt that are now displaying huge power signatures.

We can only surmise that these asteroids serve as some kind of hive for a previously unknown spaceborne life form. Whatever they are, our expanding mining operations seem to have provoked them into action!

descriptions.zh:
快速移动的攻击机正在袭击我们位于[hiver_system.GetName]星系内的开采站！这些身份不明的攻击者从一些此前在环带中休眠着的小行星中蜂拥而出，这些小行星现在正散发出强烈的能量信号。

由于我们最近的开采行动，小行星内的巢穴受到了刺激。似乎我们和它在这个星系是一山不容二虎了。
descriptions.en:
Fast-moving attack craft are hitting our mining stations in the [hiver_system.GetName] system! These unidentified aggressors swarmed out of several previously dormant asteroids in the belt that are now displaying huge power signatures.

The hive inside of the asteroid has become agitated by our recent mining. It seems this system isn't big enough for the both of us.

options.script: name = "leviathans.3201.a"

descriptions.zh:
[hiver_system.GetName]恒星系是一种具有独特性质的异常密集小行星环带的家乡。一些大型的小行星表面覆盖着突出的结晶，似乎是非常丰富的矿物矿藏。

然而，远程传感器正在追踪几个小型的、无法识别的可能是宇宙飞船的物体的零星运动，它们位于环带中的密度较大的区域。我们无法准确对其定位，但我们已经确定了至少两个被摧毁的采矿站的碎片，它们漂浮在一些较大小行星附近的太空中。
descriptions.en:
The [hiver_system.GetName] system is home to an unusually dense asteroid belt with unique properties. Several of the larger asteroids are covered in crystalline outcroppings that appear to be extremely rich mineral deposits.

However, long-range sensors are tracking sporadic movement from several small, unidentifiable objects - possibly spacecraft - in the denser regions of the belt. We are unable to get a fix on them, but we have identified debris from at least two destroyed mining stations, floating in space near some of the larger asteroids.

descriptions.zh:
[hiver_system.GetName]恒星系是一种具有独特性质的异常密集小行星环带的家乡。一些大型的小行星表面覆盖着突出的结晶，似乎是非常丰富的矿物矿藏。

我们探测到了环带中的异动：一个蜂巢思维的初级形式正在享用其矿物储备。我们可以吸收他们的意识，在我们的引导下他们将会是更强大的战力。
descriptions.en:
The [hiver_system.GetName] system is home to an unusually dense asteroid belt with unique properties. Several of the larger asteroids are covered in crystalline outcroppings that appear to be extremely rich mineral deposits.

We have detected movement within the belt: a form of rudimentary hive mind, feasting on its mineral hoard. We could subsume their consciousness and under our guidance they would be a powerful deterrent.

label.zh: 他们与我们相似，让他们为我们服务。
label.en: They are similar. Let them serve.

label.zh: 让我们看看他们会对我们作何反应。
label.en: Let's see how they react to us.

descriptions.zh:
我们的部队成功摧毁了[hive_system.GetName]星系的外星蜂巢小行星。该地区没有再出现任何攻击机了。

其中一个小行星虽然受到猛烈攻击但却大致完好无损。我们可以考虑派出一支科研队上去查看下。
descriptions.en:
Our forces have managed to smash the alien hive asteroids in the [hive_system.GetName] system. They are once again dormant, and we are not detecting any more of those vicious attack craft.

One of the asteroids is still reasonably intact, despite the damage inflicted upon it. We should consider dispatching a science party to see what we can find inside it.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科研队完成了对[hive_system.GetName]星系的蜂巢小行星内部的庞大隧道网络的探索。科学家们没有遇到之前袭击我们的那些太空生命体，但是却发现了类似孵化室的残骸。

这些发现可以让我们进一步研究该生命体的生命周期，增强我们对宇宙生物学的认知。
descriptions.en:
Our science team has finished exploring the massive network of tunnels and chambers running through the hive asteroid in the [hive_system.GetName] system. No live specimens of the spaceborne creatures that attacked us were encountered, but the scientists did find the remains of some kind of birthing chamber.

This has given us a great deal of insight into the life cycle of these entities, further expanding our understanding of galactic biology.

descriptions.zh: [from.solar_system.GetName]恒星系的原住民被惊醒了。尽管仍对多数的太空船保持敌意，但我们大可以放心，在这些全新的原始无人机的保护下，[from.solar_system.GetName]将会是一座坚不可摧的堡垒。
descriptions.en: The inhabitants of the [from.solar_system.GetName] system have awoken. While still hostile to most spacecraft, we can rest easy knowing that [from.solar_system.GetName] will be a bastion under the protection of our new primitive drones.

options.script: name = EXCELLENT
